queue_lifecycle.description: Durable queue state transitions, PREPARED, STARTING, RUNNING, COMPLETED, and UNKNOWN states verified.

cross_runtime_handoff.description: Safe runtime handoff across codex1..3 and agy1..3 aliases with isolated process groups and non-interference.

receipt_integrity.description: Deterministic receipt generation, digest chaining, schema adherence, and durable receipt storage verified.

read_only_boundary.description: Read-only workspace invariants, git worktree immutability, and index/ref protection verified.

secret_sanitization.description: Zero raw credential/token exposure in logs, receipts, state files, or error descriptors.

raw_stream_non_retention.description: Strict stdout/stderr stream length bounds, zero raw-stream retention, and no provider stream echoing.

fail_closed_circuits.description: Fail-closed behavior on capacity lease expiry, drift, malformed payloads, timeouts, and process group failures.
